# Open Source MausBotAlternatives

## A curated collection of the 6 best open source alternatives to MausBot.

The best open source alternative to MausBotis OpenClaw. If that doesn't suit you, we've compiled a ranked list of other open source MausBot alternatives to help you find a suitable replacement. Other interesting open source alternatives to MausBot are: Hermes Agent, NanoClaw, Eigent, and OpenBot.

MausBotalternatives are mainly AI Personal Assistants but may also be AI Agent Platforms. Browse these if you want a narrower list of alternatives or looking for a specific functionality of MausBot.

Piotr Kulpinski's profile

### Written by Piotr Kulpinski

Favicon of MausBot

### MausBot [...] Knowledge agent answers questions from connected company documents (Google Drive, OneDrive) and always cites the source files, so answers can be verified rather than trusted.
 Metrics agent queries your analytics warehouse and draws the answer directly instead of describing it in prose.
 Research agent gathers context across documents and drafts from them, keeping contradictory sources rather than quietly picking one.
 Tool operator signs into interfaces that have no useful API and drives them the way a person would. You can watch the screen in real time and take control mid-task.
 Inbox triage, onboarding buddy, and other role-based agents can be published and scoped to exactly the skills they need. [...] It positions itself as a lightweight alternative to OpenClaw, which ships 3,680 source files and 70 dependencies. That size difference isn't cosmetic. It shapes whether you can audit what your agent actually does, customize it without fear, and trust its security model.

Security is structural, not policy-based. Each agent group runs in its own Linux container with its own filesystem. It can only see directories you explicitly mount. Credentials never enter the container at all. Outbound API requests route through OneCLI's Agent Vault, which injects authentication at the proxy level and enforces per-agent rate limits and policies.

# OpenMausBot

The open-source Grok Bot alternative: your own team of AI bots, in a chat app.

openmausbot.com  ·  Download  ·  Open source Grok Bot alternative, compared

OpenMausBot is an open-source Grok Bot alternative: an independent project inspired by Grok Bot, and the open-source alternative to Meta Muse, OpenAI dots and Cue by Manus — bring-your-own-agent, local-first, on the models you already have. Also known as MausBot; formerly OpenGrokBot. Not affiliated with xAI, Meta, OpenAI or Manus.

Every bot in the sidebar is a real agent — Claude or Codex running locally under the hood — with its own personality, its own model, its own cloud computer, and its own connected apps. Talk to them like contacts. Watch them work. Approve what matters. [...] ## The open-source alternative to Grok Bot, Muse, dots and Cue

Four closed personal-agent products shipped in seven weeks of 2026, and each one keeps the model, the computer and your data on its maker's side of the line. OpenMausBot is the open-source version of that shape: a team of agents in a chat app, each with its own model, its own computer and its own connected apps, running on your machine under Apache 2.0. If you searched for an open Muse, open dots, an open-source Grok Bot, an open Instinct or an open Cue, this is the repository. [...] ```
npm install -g openmausbot openmausbot
```

Or use `npx openmausbot` without a global install. First launch guides you with arrow-key choices: choose AI access, sign in or paste a hidden API key, choose a model, and optionally connect a phone. Next time, the same command reuses your saved setup and opens OpenMausBot on this computer. Keep the terminal open; Ctrl-C stops the server, not your saved work. Use `--no-open` to skip opening the browser.

### Hark Pro alternative

  Hark Pro, launched by Brett Adcock's Hark Labs on October 6, 2026, is one assistant on the web, iOS and Android that does errands in its own cloud browser, free with a usage cap and $20 or $100 a month for more. MausBot is the open source Hark Pro alternative: a team of bots on any model, on your own machine, Apache 2.0, with a desktop app and phone apps.

  Also searched: Hark AI, hark.com, Brett Adcock Hark
 xAI

  ### Grok Bot alternative

  Grok Bot is xAI's roster of AI bots in a messaging app, Grok only, on one shared cloud computer, included with SuperGrok and Cursor plans. MausBot is the open source Grok Bot alternative: the same shape, free under Apache 2.0, with any model per bot, running on your own machine on the accounts you already have. [...] ### Instinct alternative

  Instinct is an invite-only personal agent you text on iMessage or WhatsApp; it runs on a cloud computer that holds your passwords and acts without asking by default. MausBot is the open source Instinct alternative: a team of agents on your own machine that sign in over OAuth, ask before they act, and need no invite.

  Also searched: open Instinct, Instinct AI invite, is Instinct safe
 OpenClaw Foundation

  ### OpenClaw alternative

  OpenClaw is the most-starred self-hosted agent: a gateway you run on a server and reach through WhatsApp, Telegram and twenty other channels, with shell execution set to full by default. MausBot is the OpenClaw alternative for people who want a desktop app with an approval gate, no exposed port, and any model per bot. [...] ### Claude Cowork alternative

  Claude Cowork is Anthropic's app for giving Claude your files, apps and browser, now part of the single Claude experience on every paid plan. MausBot is the open source Cowork alternative: a team of agents on your own machine where a Claude bot sits next to Codex and Grok bots, with approval cards and your data on your own disk.

  Also searched: Claude Cowork alternative open source, Claude Cowork for Windows, Claude Cowork local LLM
